column3: Close to the Hebrew; רָגְשׁוּ (“conspire, be in tumult”) is rendered “rage.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV capitalizes “His Anointed” as messianic and supplies “saying.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV capitalizes “Their bonds… Their cords,” referring to the LORD and His Anointed.
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV capitalizes “My King,” and “mountain of holiness” is rendered “holy hill.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV capitalizes “My Son… You” as messianic.
Close to the Hebrew; “rulers” is rendered “judges.”
Close to the Hebrew; “kiss the son” is capitalized as “Kiss the Son,” and “seek refuge” is rendered “put their trust.”
